title: KYA-OS Audit Record
description: Versioned, portable audit log record summarizing a single verified KYA-OS tool call. Provides a standard, cross-implementation format for compliance and non-repudiation trails (audit.v1).

ts.description: Unix timestamp in seconds when the record was generated.

session.description: Session identifier the tool call belongs to.

audience.description: Intended audience of the call (server DID or URL).

did.description: DID of the agent that made the call.

kid.description: Key identifier of the signing key (matches the proof JWS header kid).

reqHash.description: SHA-256 hash of the JCS-canonicalized request. Format: 'sha256:<64 hex chars>'.

resHash.description: SHA-256 hash of the JCS-canonicalized response. Format: 'sha256:<64 hex chars>'. Optional: omitted when the call produced no response body to bind (e.g. a denied or step-up-required outcome), mirroring the optional responseHash in the detached-proof schema.

verified.description: Whether the call's detached proof verified against the signer's DID.

scope.description: Scope string associated with the call.
